definitions.explanation: A person whose profession is teaching, typically at a school or educational institution. A formal and official term for the teaching profession.

examples.japanese: {教員|きょういん}{免許|めんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
{教員|きょういん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}{試験|しけん}→採用試験：29861_saiyoushiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I passed the teacher recruitment exam.

examples.japanese: {教員|きょういん}⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are regions where a shortage of teachers has become a serious problem.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term used in administrative, legal, and institutional contexts. More official than ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧ (teacher, used in everyday address and conversation) or ⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧ (teacher, slightly formal). {教員|きょういん} is the standard term in regulations, job postings, and discussions about the teaching profession.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教員|きょういん}{免許|めんきょ}: teaching license
- {教員|きょういん}⟦{採用|さいよう}{試験|しけん}→採用試験：29861_saiyoushiken⟧: teacher recruitment exam
- {教員|きょういん}⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧: teacher shortage
- {教員|きょういん}⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧: teacher training
- {教員|きょういん}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: number of teachers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: teacher (everyday, respectful address)
- ⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧: teacher (slightly formal, emphasizes the role)
- ⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧: lecturer, instructor (part-time or at university level)
